in_arabic.name: ودود
in_arabic.meaning: اسم الله الحسنى، محب، حبيب، عاشق
in_arabic.long_meaning: من أسماء الله الحسنى، ودود يعني المحب لحب الله لعباده، ومنه قوله: وَهُوَ الْوَدُودُ الْعَزِيزُ، أي: يحب عباده المؤمنين، وهم يحبونه

in_urdu.name: ودود
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کا نام، محبت کرنے والا، پیارا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک، ودود کا مطلب ہے محبت کرنے والا یا پیارا، جو اللہ کی محبت اپنے بندوں کے ساتھ بیان کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: वदूद
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह का नाम, प्रेम करने वाला, प्रिय
in_hindi.long_meaning: अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक, वदूद का अर्थ है प्रेम करने वाला या प्रिय, जो अल्लाह की अपने सेवकों के प्रति प्रेम को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: ودود
in_pashto.meaning: د الله نوم، مینه کوونکی، ګران
in_pashto.long_meaning: د الله تعالی ښوونکي نومونه، ودود د معنی مینه کوونکی یا ګران، چی د الله د مینې خپلو بندګانو سره څرګندوي

in_english.name: Wadood
in_english.meaning: One of Allah's names, loving, beloved
in_english.long_meaning: One of the beautiful names of Allah, Wadood means loving or beloved, which signifies Allah's love towards His servants, derived from Arabic root 'w-d-w-d' implying love, affection

data.cultural_impact: The name "Wadood" represents the Islamic virtues of kindness, love and being friendly to others. In Islamic culture, these values are highly cherished and form the foundation of building strong relationships both in personal and communal life. The name "Wadood" serves as a reminder for Muslims to embody these qualities and contribute to creating a harmonious and peaceful society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Wadood" is a reflection of the God-given nature of being compassionate and caring towards others. It is an invitation and reminder for the bearer of this name to strive towards love, kindness and generosity, not just towards humans, but towards all creation. By embodying these qualities, we reflect the great mercy and compassion of Allah and partake in the ongoing process of creating a beautiful and loving world, both in this life and the next.
